The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," plots "Training Rewards" along the y-axis using a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.4 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains two solid lines, each lacking data marker shapes and surrounded by a faint shaded region representing variance. A solid dark teal line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," begins near 0.02 at 0 steps, climbs rapidly to a high point of roughly 0.38 at 250 steps, and then fluctuates slightly downward before ending near 0.33 at 500 steps. A solid dark red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," begins at approximately the same point near 0.02 and rises steadily with repeating oscillations. It surpasses the teal line, reaches a peak of approximately 0.41 near 480 steps, and concludes at about 0.40 at the 500-step mark.

The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," represents "Training Rewards" on its y-axis, utilizing a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.2 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Similar to the top graph, it displays two solid lines without markers, accompanied by faint shaded regions. A solid dark teal line, denoting "Llama-On-Policy-Hard," starts at approximately 0.03 at 0 steps, decreases steadily to 0.0 by 100 steps, and remains completely flat at 0.0 for the remainder of the 500 steps. A solid dark red line, corresponding to "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," begins at roughly 0.01 at 0 steps and demonstrates a continuous upward trajectory marked by jagged fluctuations across the entire x-axis range. It attains a value near 0.1 at 100 steps, hits a peak of approximately 0.21 around 490 steps, and finishes slightly lower near 0.20 at 500 steps.
